title: Marcos arrives in China to attend APEC Leaders' Meeting
summary: President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. arrived in China on Wednesday ahead of his participation in the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting.

blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. arrived in China on Wednesday ahead of his participation in the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting.
The PR001 carrying the President and his delegation landed at the Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport at 5:30 p.m.
Marcos is expected to attend a gala dinner in Shenzhen tonight (Wednesday evening).
The APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting will be held from November 18 to 19, preceded by an annual summit of CEOs on November 17 to 18.
Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected to welcome the world leaders who will be attending the meeting as the host for APEC 2026.
The APEC is a regional forum of 21 member-economies in the Asia-Pacific. The theme of this year's summit is "Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together."
While in China's southern technology hub of Shenzhen, Marcos is expected to have bilateral meetings with several world leaders, including Chilean President José Antonio Kast.
Marcos' visit in China comes after the Philippines' hosting of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit and Related Summits from November 15 to 17, 2026.
Earlier on Wednesday, US President Donald Trump arrived at Malacañang as part of his state visit to the Philippines. He was accompanied by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
Trump was also set to fly to China to participate in the APEC summit. — VDV, GMA News
